meta.note: Times are Belize local exactly as BEL printed them. 'ALL' for feeder or zone is a real value, not missing data.

outages.raw_text:
5-Minute power interruption to occur anytime between 4am and 4:30am
Load Center: Ladyville.
Feeder: 1.
Zone: 3.
Areas to be affected: areas along Philip Goldson Highway from Henderson Avenue at Mile 2.5 to Fen Lan at Mile 4.5 including Mayflower Drive, Chetumal Street from Philip Goldson Highway to Park Street, entire Bella Vista, Belama Phase 2, Belama Phase 3, Belama Phase 4 and North End Estate.

5-Minute power interruption to occur anytime between 5am and 6am
Load Center: Belize City.
Feeder: 2,4,6 & 8.
Zone: All
Areas to be affected: the portion of Belize City that includes Freetown Road from ITVET to Barrack Road, the portion of the Fort George area that includes Barrack Road, Craig Street, Eve Street, Daly Street, Handyside Street, Gabourel Lane, Goal Lane, Hunters Lane, and Pink's Alley; Cleghorn Street, Slaughterhouse Road,  Sun Dry Street, portion of Douglas Jones Street, New Road, Queen Street, Victoria Street, New Road, Pickstock Street, Hyde’s Lane, Fort Street, Goldson Lane, Dredge Street, Eyre Street, Cork Street, South Park Street, Taiwan Street, Gabourel Lane, Sister Caritas Lawrence Lane, William Fonseca Street, and the section of Marine Parade from Fort Street to Sister Caritas Lawrence Lane; areas between St. Thomas Street and Princess Margaret Drive including University Drive, Captain Eiley Street and Mercy Lane; Kelly Street, Fuller’s Lane, Wilson Street, Barrack Road, Princess Margaret Drive from Barrack Road to University Drive, Baymen Avenue, Newtown Barracks, Nurse Seay Street, Simon Lamb Street, Matron Roberts Street, Calle al Mar, St. Joseph Street, St. Peter Street, Landivar Street, Guadalupe Street, Hopkin’s Street, St. James Street, 2nd Street, 3rd Street, C Street, 5th Street, 7th Street, B Street, D Street, 10th Street, 14th Street, A Street, 18th Street, E Street, H Street, St. Charles Street, St. Edward Street, St. John Street, St. Luke Street, St. Mark Street, and St. Matthew Street, the portion of Lizarraga Avenue between Gentle Avenue and Meighan Avenue, Gentle Avenue, Vasquez Avenue, Smith Street, the portion of Lottie Waight Street between Lizarraga Avenue and Meighan Avenue, the portion of Meighan Avenue between Princess Margaret Drive and Lottie Waight Street, and Goldson Avenue.

5-Minute power interruption to occur anytime between 6am and 7am
Load Center: Belize City.
Feeder: 1,3,5 & 7.
Zone: All
Areas to be affected: the portion of downtown Belize City from West Canal to Southern Foreshore, Cemetery Road from Central American Boulevard roundabout to Pound Yard, Magazine Road, Dolphin Street, Fairweather Street, and the portion of West Canal between King Street to Berkley Street, Vernon Street from Magazine Road to George Price Highway. The portion of Belize City that includes entire Central American Boulevard, entire Port Loyola area, entire Lake Independence area, Lake Independence Boulevard, George Price Highway from Mile 1 to Lake Independence Boulevard, Krooman Road, Wilda Codington Street, Gilda Pipersburgh Street, Gison Street, Ramiro Duran Street.
